words.definition_en: to fry quickly in a small amount of hot fat
example_sentences: Sauté the onions until golden.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to gently combine a light ingredient into a mixture
example_sentences: Fold in the egg whites carefully.

words.definition_en: to shred food into small pieces using a grater
example_sentences: Grate some cheese on top.

words.definition_en: to cut food into small cubes
example_sentences: Dice the onion finely.

words.definition_en: to cut food into very small pieces
example_sentences: Mince the garlic before adding it to the pan.

words.definition_en: (of food) become bad or unsafe to eat
example_sentences: The milk has gone off.

words.definition_en: (of meat) soft and easy to cut or chew
example_sentences: The steak was incredibly tender.

words.definition_en: pleasantly hard and crunchy
example_sentences: The chicken skin was perfectly crispy.

words.definition_en: unpleasantly wet and soft
example_sentences: The chips went soggy in the box.

words.definition_en: having a taste that is salty rather than sweet
example_sentences: I prefer savoury snacks to sweet ones.

words.definition_en: having a sharp, tart, or acidic taste
example_sentences: The dressing has a tangy lemon flavour.

words.definition_en: having a fresh, sharp, and lively flavour, often citrus
example_sentences: The marinade has a zesty lime kick.

words.definition_en: (of food) having a strong, satisfying flavour, often fatty or sweet
example_sentences: The chocolate cake was very rich.

words.definition_en: having a sharp, unpleasant taste, like coffee without sugar
example_sentences: Dark chocolate can taste quite bitter.

words.definition_en: having a sharp, acidic taste, like a lemon
example_sentences: The yoghurt tasted a bit sour.

words.definition_en: looking or smelling extremely appetising
example_sentences: The smell coming from the kitchen was mouth-watering.

words.definition_en: looking or smelling attractive to eat
example_sentences: The dish looked really appetising.

words.definition_en: containing or covered in too much fat or oil
example_sentences: The fries were a bit too greasy for me.

words.definition_en: good for health; simple and natural
example_sentences: They serve wholesome, home-cooked meals.

words.definition_en: food that has been industrially altered from its natural state
example_sentences: We try to avoid processed food.

words.definition_en: food remaining after a meal
example_sentences: We had the leftovers for lunch the next day.

words.definition_en: idiom: using raw ingredients, not pre-made products
example_sentences: She made the whole cake from scratch.

words.definition_en: collocation: to book a table at a restaurant in advance
example_sentences: We made a reservation for eight o'clock.

words.definition_en: to share the cost of a meal between several people
example_sentences: Shall we split the bill?

words.definition_en: to give extra money to a server as a reward
example_sentences: We left a generous tip.

words.definition_en: someone who is very selective about the food they eat
example_sentences: My son is such a picky eater.

words.translation_pt: um sabor que se aprende a gostar
words.definition_en: idiom: something you only start to like after trying it several times
example_sentences: Blue cheese is definitely an acquired taste.

words.definition_en: idiom: something very easy to do
example_sentences: The exam was a piece of cake.
